_comment: Corrections for venues football-data.org has not updated. Their club metadata has lastUpdated 2022. Remove entries once upstream is fixed.

62.reason: Everton moved from Goodison Park for the 2025/26 season

87.reason: "Estadio del Rayo Vallecano" geocoded to a street address on Av. de la Albufera; the ground is Estadio de Vallecas. Verified: query "Estadio de Vallecas, Spain" [country:ES] returned "C. del Payaso Fofó, 0, Puente de Vallecas, 28018 Madrid, Spain" with types establishment, point_of_interest, stadium

113.reason: football-data still lists Stadio San Paolo, renamed Stadio Diego Armando Maradona in 2020; its stored city was "Province of Caserta", ~23km from the ground. Verified: query "Stadio Diego Armando Maradona, Italy" [country:IT] returned "Via Giambattista Marino, 80125 Napoli NA, Italy" with types establishment, point_of_interest, stadium

471.reason: football-data lists city Sassuolo, but the Mapei Stadium is in Reggio Emilia ~24km away; the stored coordinates were the Sassuolo town centroid. Verified: query "Mapei Stadium Reggio Emilia, Italy" [country:IT] returned "Piazzale Atleti Azzuri D'Italia, 1, 42122 Reggio Emilia RE, Italy" with types establishment, point_of_interest, stadium

583.venue: Parque de Jogos Comendador Joaquim de Almeida Freitas
583.reason: "P.D. Comendador Joaquim de Almeida Freitas" geocoded to the avenue of the same name rather than the ground. Verified: query "Parque de Jogos Comendador Joaquim de Almeida Freitas, Portugal" [country:PT] returned "Av. Comendador Joaquim de Almeida Freitas, 4870-270 Moreira de Cónegos, Portugal" with types establishment, point_of_interest, stadium

610.reason: Türk Telekom Arena was renamed RAMS Park; the stale name geocoded to a street rather than the ground. Verified: query "RAMS Park, TUR" [country:TR] returned "Huzur, Metin Oktay Caddesi, 34386 Sarıyer/İstanbul, Türkiye" with types establishment, point_of_interest, stadium

1076.reason: football-data still lists St Andrew's from the Birmingham groundshare; their coordinates are already correct for Coventry, but their address was also corrected - it resolved to Gallagher Retail Park, a neighbouring site, rather than the stadium

1780.reason: "Estádio Club de Regatas Vasco da Gama" geocoded to a city-centre address; the ground is Estádio São Januário. Verified: query "Estádio São Januário, Brazil" [country:BR] returned "Av. Roberto Dinamite, 10 - Vasco da Gama, Rio de Janeiro - RJ, 20921-060, Brazil" with types establishment, point_of_interest, stadium

1887.reason: football-data lists the Metalist complex (Kharkiv) and the cached coordinate was in Malaysia (1.87, 102.93); Shakhtar play home games at Arena Lviv in exile. Verified: query "Arena Lviv, UKR" [country:UA] returned "Stryiska St, 199, L'viv, L'vivs'ka oblast, Ukraine, 79031" with types establishment, point_of_interest, stadium

5530.reason: "Cidade do Futebol" geocoded to the Ponta Delgada town centroid; the ground is Estádio de São Miguel. Verified: query "Estádio de São Miguel, Portugal" [country:PT] returned "Estr. Regional da Ribeira Grande 1097, 9500-702, Portugal" with types establishment, point_of_interest, stadium

5890.reason: football-data lists "Stadio Comunale Via Del Mare"; geocoding that matched a road in Matino ~36km away. Verified: query "Stadio Via del Mare, Italy" [country:IT] returned "Via del Mare, 73100 Lecce LE, Italy" with types establishment, point_of_interest, stadium

7822.reason: "Campo Futebol Clube Alverca" geocoded to a street address on Av. Infante Dom Pedro. Verified: query "Estádio do Alverca, Portugal" [country:PT] returned "R. César Augusto Gonçalves Ferreira 2615, 2615-391 Alverca do Ribatejo, Portugal" with types establishment, point_of_interest, stadium

9136.reason: football-data lists "Estádio Nacional" with no city and null coordinates; the club plays at Estádio José Gomes in Amadora. Verified: query "Estádio José Gomes Amadora, Portugal" [country:PT] returned "Av. Dr. José Pontes, 2720-206 Amadora, Portugal" with types establishment, point_of_interest, stadium
